dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what's wrong? You look angry.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌts ˈrɔːŋ? juː ˈlʊk ˈæŋɡri.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's Pete. He's always posting selfies!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈpiːt. hiːz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈpoʊstɪŋ ˈsɛlfiz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What's wrong with that? Everyone posts selfies.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌts ˈrɔːŋ wɪð ˈðæt? ˈɛvriwʌn ˈpoʊsts ˈsɛlfiz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not twenty a day! And he's always showing off his new clothes and his car.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈtwɛnti ə ˈdeɪ! ənd hiːz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈʃoʊɪŋ ˈɔːf hɪz ˈnuː ˈkloʊðz ənd hɪz ˈkɑːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! I know people like that. Does he use a lot of filters, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! aɪ ˈnoʊ ˈpiːpəl laɪk ˈðæt. dʌz hiː ˈjuːz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfɪltərz, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! He always uses a filter, so he looks like a different person.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! hiː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈjuːzɪz ə ˈfɪltər, soʊ hiː ˈlʊks laɪk ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈpɜːrsən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then don't look at his posts.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈdoʊnt ˈlʊk ət hɪz ˈpoʊsts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I try, but every time I scroll, I see his face!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈtraɪ, bʌt ˈɛvri ˈtaɪm aɪ ˈskroʊl, aɪ ˈsiː hɪz ˈfeɪs!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's annoying! But you're always checking your phone, too, Nam.
dialogue.reading: ðæts əˈnɔɪɪŋ! bʌt jʊr ˈɔːlweɪz ˈtʃɛkɪŋ jʊr ˈfoʊn, ˈtuː, ˈnɑːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hey! That's not true… OK, maybe it's a little true.
dialogue.reading: ˈheɪ! ðæts ˈnɑːt ˈtruː… oʊˈkeɪ, ˈmeɪbi ɪts ə ˈlɪtəl ˈtruː.
